content_constraints: Do not invent hours, services, licenses, team, prices, promises or testimonials.
Google rating is a dated observation.
Verify independent website, residential service scope, independence and capacity before a speculative build.
Keep customer submissions and outgoing actions disabled pending owner verification.
No owner photographs cleared; use original illustrations.
A public Maps address is not postal deliverability certification.
Build the website in English only. All customer-facing pages, navigation, forms, metadata and messages must be English. Do not add a French version or language switcher.

If transactional features are built, complete the dossier's regional requirements before enabling live charges: confirm job location, tax registrations, supply taxability, current rates, payment timing, CAD totals and applicable customer terms. Reference rates are not an active tax configuration.

taxes.jurisdiction_rule: For ordinary on-site plumbing tied to one property, use the job property's province. Apply the appropriate place-of-supply rules separately to goods and other services; the business address alone does not determine tax.

business_province_reference.note: No provincial sales tax in the CRA reference table. Confirm federal registration, supply classification and exemptions.

confirm_before_configuration: Supplier legal identity, GST/HST and applicable QST/PST/RST registrations, effective dates and exemptions
Actual job/delivery location and supply classification for labour, materials, installed fixtures and retail-only goods
Current effective rates and taxability for each line item and applicable customer exemption evidence
Tax-inclusive or tax-exclusive pricing, separate tax labels, subtotal, rounding and final CAD total
Whether a payment is a true deposit, advance, progress payment or holdback, including refund or forfeiture treatment

timezone.instruction: Use the local booking timezone and its daylight-saving rules. Do not infer a single timezone from the province.

regional_requirements.customer_terms: Confirm province-appropriate estimate, deposit, cancellation, refund and warranty terms for the enabled features. Display only verified licence or permit claims.
regional_requirements.builder_validation: Before activation, verify representative taxable and exempt cases, job provinces, rate dates, mixed labour/materials, deposits and refunds. Confirm displayed totals match the payment provider and invoice.
regional_requirements.address_and_service_area: Use Canadian address, province, postal-code and phone formats. Confirm job eligibility, service area, travel and call-out charges with the owner.

qualification.reason: Plumber category on Google Maps; 4.7/5 with 10 reviews; public phone; No website linked on Google Maps. Profile individually opened. An absent Maps website link does not establish that no independent website exists.
qualification.scope_evidence: BBB lists mechanical contractor, commercial plumber and heating categories. Residential offer and suitable project type need confirmation.
qualification.address_conflict: BBB also lists 9508 110 Street and PO-box postal code; Maps and Yellow Pages both show 9107 111 St. Confirm mailing address before outreach.
